entries.title: Crude oil futures drop after Trump promises an Iran deal will be signed Friday

entries.title: 2-2 draw for Japan and the Netherlands in World Cup opener for both
entries.snippet: Daichi Kamada scored on a header off Koki Ogawa's corner kick in the 88th minute, sending the Samurai Blue fans into a frenzy and giving Japan a 2-2 draw with the Netherlands in their World Cup opener.

entries.title: Havertz sparks Germany's 7-1 rout of Curaçao after underdogs' historic 1st goal in World Cup
entries.snippet: Kai Havertz scored two goals as Germany pulled away from World Cup first-timer Curaçao late in the opening half and piled on after that in a 7-1 win in a group match.

entries.title: Fate of historic slavery exhibit targeted by Trump hangs in the balance
entries.snippet: A federal judge has temporarily blocked President Trump's order to remove some exhibits at national parks. One historic site targeted by that order faces an uncertain future.

entries.snippet: President Trump said the U.S. would remove its blockade of the Strait of Hormuz and said a deal will be signed on Friday.

entries.title: Putin and Zelenskyy each speak with Trump by phone as drone strikes kill 2 in Russia and U.K. detains tanker
entries.snippet: Russian President Vladimir Putin and Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy each spoke by phone with U.S. President Donald Trump on Sunday.

entries.title: Eastern Congo reports 782 Ebola cases and 181 deaths, authorities say
entries.snippet: The number of confirmed Ebola cases in Congo has increased to 782, with 181 deaths, the Congolese Ministry of Health said in a statement on social platform X on Sunday evening.

entries.title: Taiwan's intelligence agency launches webpage for Chinese nationals to report tips
entries.snippet: Taiwan's intelligence agency said on Sunday it is establishing an information-reporting channel for Chinese nationals to offer tips securely.

entries.title: 12 dead in crash of plane on skydiving outing in Missouri, authorities say
entries.snippet: The crash happened shortly after the plane took off from a local airport around 11:30 a.m., and some of the occupants' family members witnessed the crash, said Bates County Sheriff Chad Anderson.

entries.snippet: Two helicopters collided over Rio de Janeiro on Sunday morning and crashed in the city's western zone, killing all six people aboard, firefighters said.

entries.title: Britain detains sanctioned oil tanker suspected of ties to Russia's shadow fleet

entries.title: Nara Organics recalls baby formula after multistate infant botulism outbreak
entries.snippet: Nara Organics recalled its organic baby formula sold nationwide in Target stores and online Saturday after a multistate outbreak of infant botulism, federal authorities said.

entries.title: Protesters in Geneva clash with police ahead of the G7 summit in nearby France
entries.snippet: A violent standoff extended into the evening after a series of incidents — including a car set ablaze and a bank's windows smashed — along the route of an afternoon march that drew an estimated 20,000 people.

entries.title: Trump celebrates 80th birthday with Iran deal ahead of UFC fights on White House South Lawn
entries.snippet: Trump marked turning 80 on Sunday by hailing an agreement to end the war in Iran hours before a birthday celebration that once would have seemed unfathomable: a cage-fighting show on the South Lawn of the White House.

entries.title: Georgia's vote-counting method will soon be banned. Lawmakers will try to find a fix this week
entries.snippet: Legislators passed a law two years ago barring the use of the QR code printed on ballots that the state relies on to tally votes beyond July 1 of this year, but no replacement method was ever implemented.

entries.title: Palestinian death toll in Gaza tops 73,000, officials say, as Israel strikes despite ceasefire
entries.snippet: Israel says it is targeting Hamas and other militants who pose a threat, and in response to ceasefire violations, including occasional attacks.

entries.title: Knicks win first championship in 53 years, igniting celebrations and chaos in New York City
entries.snippet: New York Knicks won their first NBA championship in 53 years on Saturday night, with exuberant celebrations marred by mayhem and violence, including a shooting in Times Square.

entries.title: Trump taps James M. McDonald as U.S. Attorney for the Southern District of New York
entries.snippet: President Donald Trump said Saturday that he will appoint one of his personal lawyers to serve as the top federal prosecutor in Manhattan.

entries.title: Tens of thousands march at Pride events in Romania and Bulgaria to demand equality
entries.snippet: Romania and Bulgaria do not recognize same-sex marriage or civil partnerships, despite the bloc prohibiting discrimination based on sexual orientation.

entries.title: Ukrainian drone strike kills 1 and injures 3 in southern Russia

entries.title: OpenAI hit with multistate probe into possible user harm as its IPO looms
entries.snippet: The company behind the popular chatbot ChatGPT said it will respond to the inquiry "constructively" and that it already has in place measures to protect its customers.

entries.title: Macron to host Trump for dinner at Versailles after G7 summit

entries.title: Trump hosts White House cage fights to mark 80th birthday
entries.snippet: The US president is set to watch seven fights with an audience of 4,000 people inside a specially built arena on the White House lawn. Critics say the unprecendented spectacle is in poor taste amid the ongoing Iran war.

entries.title: UK seizes suspected Russian shadow fleet tanker
entries.snippet: UK forces on Sunday intercepted a sanctioned Russian ship, with navy commandos rappelling onboard from helicopters. The UK and Ukraine hailed the move, saying it robbed Russia of money for its ongoing war of aggression.

entries.snippet: Unverified footage on social media showed that a key chemical plant in Russia may have been hit. Meanwhile, the Uk has intercepted a Russian shadow fleet tanker.

entries.title: Sahel juntas are 'crushing' basic freedoms
entries.snippet: In the Sahel countries of Mali, Burkina Faso, and Niger, military rulers are increasingly clamping down on press freedom and freedom of expression. Many journalists, bloggers and activists have been forced into exile.

entries.title: Why is Bulgaria banning arms supplies to Ukraine?
entries.snippet: Bulgaria's new government has banned state arms supplies to Ukraine. The ban does not, however, affect commercial exports, raising the question as to whether the move was aimed more at a domestic audience than at Kyiv.

entries.title: Swiss voters reject population cap proposal
entries.snippet: A proposal to introduce a population cap of 10 million in the country has failed. It was put forward by a hard-right party.

entries.title: New York Knicks win first NBA championship in 53 years
entries.snippet: Series MVP Jalen Brunson has led the New York Knicks to another comeback victory over the San Antonio Spurs. The win secured the franchise's third NBA championship, and its first since 1973.

entries.title: Manuel Neuer fit to join Germany in first World Cup match
entries.snippet: Veteran goalkeeper Manuel Neuer is set to play in Germany's first match in this year's World Cup. He had retired from the national team in August 2024.

entries.title: The creatives trying to fix Germany's bureaucracy

entries.title: Italy: Thousands attend anti- and pro-migration rallies in Rome
entries.snippet: Tens of thousands of people demonstrated in the Italian capital for rival protests. The rallies took place after a proposed bill seeking measures against migrants secured enough support to be brought before parliament.

entries.title: Mexico: Mayor shot dead in Oaxaca state

entries.title: Belfast: Thousands denounce violence at anti-racism rally
entries.snippet: Protesters condemned the scenes of anti-immigrant violence seen earlier in the week, which were in response to an alleged knife attack by a Sudanese refugee.

entries.title: Fact check: These FIFA World Cup ticket sites are fake

entries.title: Nigeria: Abducted former general dies in captivity
entries.snippet: Rabe Abubakar was abducted along with his wife by so-called bandits in the northwest. A government statement said he died from complications related to diabetes and hypertension.

entries.title: Gold rush atmosphere at Berlin's military air trade show
